Theme.Name: Visual Theme
Theme.Hint: Choose whether LiTM Visual Overhaul leaves the official style untouched or applies the Sci-Fi overhaul.

Accent.Name: Primary Accent Color
Accent.Hint: Hex color used for highlights, active tabs and interface glow. Example: #4de1ff.

Secondary.Name: Secondary Accent Color
Secondary.Hint: Hex color used for secondary neon details. Example: #c45cff.

Glow.Name: Glow Intensity
Glow.Hint: Controls the strength of neon shadows and highlights.

SharpCards.Name: Angular Cards
SharpCards.Hint: Gives cards and panels clipped technological corners.

Scanlines.Name: Subtle Scanlines
Scanlines.Hint: Adds a very light scanline overlay to system windows.

DenseUi.Name: Compact Interface
DenseUi.Hint: Reduces spacing slightly to fit more information on screen.

RollCardTranslation.Name: Roll Result Card Translation
RollCardTranslation.Hint: Translates only rendered roll-result cards in chat. Character sheets, menus, compendiums and roll dialogs are not translated.

AdvancedRollRules.Name: Advanced Roll Rules (p. 158)
AdvancedRollRules.Hint: Adds the missing p.158 roll options to the official system: Trade Power on Detailed rolls and Push Your Luck after a 10+.

Trade.Title: Trade Power
Trade.CautionHint: Final Power 2 or less: −1 to the roll; on a success, spend original Power +1.
Trade.CautionSummary: −1 to the roll; on a success, spend original Power +1.
Trade.HedgeHint: Final Power 2 or more: +1 to the roll; on a success, spend original Power −1.
Trade.HedgeSummary: +1 to the roll; on a success, spend original Power −1.

Push.Title: Push Your Luck
Push.ConfirmQuick: Accept Consequences to turn this 10+ into a Great Success?
Push.ConfirmDetailed: Accept Consequences to gain +1 Power to spend on this Detailed result?
Push.QuickResult: Great Success: the Narrator grants an extra benefit, and you accept Consequences.
Push.DetailedResult: Push Your Luck: +1 Power to spend on effects, and you accept Consequences.
